implementation.name: original-v3-radix-tree-cache
implementation.scope: Original radix prefix tree and active request path. Four drawn block symbols per node are illustrative ownership objects, not a byte-capacity model.
implementation.question: Why must eviction proceed from dormant leaves?

purpose: Why must eviction proceed from dormant leaves?
guard: Only dormant leaves are evicted. Dormant internal ancestors remain while descendants are retained; active request paths stay intact. LRU chooses among eligible leaves only.
